module Matrix.CaseRecordValues

type Account is record
    id: Integer
    active: Boolean
end record

function choose(kind: Integer) returns Account
is
    case kind is
        when 1 =>
            return Account { id: 1, active: true }
        when 2 =>
            return Account { id: 2, active: false }
        default =>
            return Account { id: 0, active: false }
    end case
end choose

procedure main()
is
    let selected: Account = choose(1)
    check selected.id = 1
end main

end Matrix.CaseRecordValues
